• Regularization: Dual dropout () integrated across classifier projection layers.

div.div: Figure 2. Architectural blueprint of Model 2 (Residual Deep CNN). The stem performs initial 3×3 spatial convolution and downsampling to 32 channels. Four modular residual stages (depth=2 each) progressively scale capacity to 256 channels via projection shortcuts (stride=2) and identity skip connections. The lower panel illustrates the internal residual anatomy mitigating gradient decay.
